line: Liquid sloshing and churning inside glass, with a hiss of snow and tiny bells in it
why: the liquid of the kept shake-spring, 40 cents higher for winter; the small sleigh bells of the cue's own take 3; the snow is the cue's own take 12 (after-review take 1, fine dry snow blowing across ice, asked for alone), 10 dB under the liquid; the liquid leads and falls away at 1.5 s, the bells ring on to the end, as in number 10
